items.action: Publish separate binding audits, constraint certificates, specialist verdicts and observable assessment rubrics.
items.observation: Source-location validity, solver validity, model agreement and student learning are different claims.
items.remaining_limit: No teacher validation, classroom pilot, misconception-prevalence measurement or calibrated learning probability exists.

items.action: Use thirty reviewed official textbook units across grades 2–6 and retain their source manifests.
items.observation: The historical forty-case prompt benchmark is not the complete national curriculum.
items.remaining_limit: Two proposed parent skills per unit are an authored abstraction, not a ministry-approved input skill map; source-topic omission still requires curriculum review.

items.action: Prefer independently assessable constructs and disclose the unmet target rather than split tasks merely to increase a count.
items.observation: The final graph has 306 micro-skills over 60 authored parent skills: 5.1x, below the requested 6x target.
items.remaining_limit: This ratio is against the authored parent map, not an externally supplied complete official skills map.

items.action: Split skill decomposition from activity-bank generation, simplify only the provider grammar, enforce full local schemas, and apply named optimizer patches.
items.observation: A full combined generation schema was rejected by Vertex and large whole-unit rewrites introduced unrelated changes.
items.remaining_limit: The unit proposal subgraph is an experimental route alongside the existing four-level hierarchy, not a demonstrated production replacement of every level.

items.action: Use criterion-specific packets and versioned 1.1 rubrics. Require four of five passing votes plus evidence/age vetoes and no critical finding. Retain every disagreement.
items.observation: Five specialist model votes are correlated and sensitive to rubric wording; some judges confuse an activity bank with a calendar or reject a supported paraphrase based on sentence form.
items.remaining_limit: Thresholds are explicit design policy, not calibrated validity. Revised content is not approved by an earlier verdict; post-verification edits remain pending.

items.action: Replace selected formal procedures with supplied-model interpretation, remove BMI and personal anthropometry, and include expected responses and scoring rules.
items.observation: The model reproduced formal quantum-number procedures in grade 5 and personal-body measurement tasks in grade 4.
items.remaining_limit: Other official topics, including error propagation and molecular geometry, remain developmentally ambitious and require teacher decisions on deferral or scaffolding.

items.action: Limit the soap claim to observed oil dispersion and use prepared potato-tissue records with model limitations for osmosis.
items.observation: An oil-and-soap demonstration was used to imply universal pathogen killing; an osmosis activity used gummy bears as if they were cell membranes.
items.remaining_limit: Exact quotations do not by themselves establish that an entire lesson or causal explanation is supported.

items.action: Retain fetched hashes, exclude repeated support, use the official second-volume guide, and admit only the NASA page-5 background for the cell-type comparison.
items.observation: The grade-2 volume-2 URL returned repeated volume-1 content; the NASA cell resource has a nucleus answer-key row contradicting its background prose.
items.remaining_limit: Official publication status does not guarantee scientific correctness or blanket open copyright.

items.action: Record the candidate as rejected pending purpose-specific review; do not download it through the automatic gate.
items.observation: The current OpenStax Biology 2e page declares CC BY-NC-SA rather than an assumed older unrestricted license.
items.remaining_limit: Rejection is a pipeline admission decision, not a statement that every reuse is prohibited.

items.action: Augment specific missing explanatory paragraphs with their original chunk, page and offsets; scope evidence judges to cited-page context.
items.observation: Two long paragraphs per page give bounded context but can omit short definitions and overrepresent exposition.
items.remaining_limit: The new books have not been embedded into the historical index. Benchmark retrieval against a teacher-annotated citation set before claiming embedding-based retrieval improves grounding.

items.action: Preserve sparse cycle checks and add four explicit adjacent-grade diagnostic handoffs at the curricularization layer.
items.observation: Most asserted prerequisites are intra-unit. Repeated topics across grades are not automatically proven dependencies.
items.remaining_limit: Global prerequisite completeness, semantic deduplication across units and calibrated AND/OR routes remain unresolved; no such proof is claimed.

items.action: Author local alternatives in the curricularization layer and solve the context assignment conditional on the temporal incumbent. Preserve earlier failed attempts.
items.observation: Intermediate schedules selected no contexts because the original bank lacked three distinct usable alternatives in several grades.
items.remaining_limit: Context selection is optimal only conditional on the fixed schedule; the overall solution remains feasible, not globally optimal.

items.action: Use CP-SAT with exact 9600 minutes per grade, a finite bank, explicit prerequisites, four continuity handoffs and independent post-solve audit.
items.observation: A structurally valid activity bank is not yet a feasible annual sequence; a feasible sequence is not an optimal instructional plan.
items.remaining_limit: Duration estimates, 32 planning weeks, context caps and cognitive targets are provisional design choices. Report misses and bounds without relabeling recall as reasoning.

items.action: Expose the complete authored bank and the actual selected calendar separately for teacher inspection.
items.observation: Temporal constraints ensure declared prerequisites but do not prove that every generated task is sufficiently scaffolded or that every assessment is selected.
items.remaining_limit: Curriculum adoption requires checking task coherence, age accessibility, domain omissions, resource availability and assessment selection; this release is a proposal only.

items.action: Retain the failing comparison and unchanged-workload references. Archive raw benchmark samples compressed and keep summary statistics readable.
items.observation: The final 20% comparison flags license-workflow mean +78.1% and eight-micro-skill compilation mean +24.5%; repeated runs show substantial timing variance.
items.remaining_limit: The performance gate is not clean; isolated-run successes do not establish stable whole-suite performance. This proposal release does not claim production readiness.
